title: High Access Employees
statement:
Find employees who badge in too frequently.

Contract
- `accesses` is non-null. Each access has an employee name and a four-character `HHmm` time on a single day.
- Return employee names, sorted alphabetically, for anyone with at least three accesses in a window strictly shorter than 60 minutes.
- Multiple accesses at the same minute count separately. Do not mutate the input list.

Examples
- `alice@0830 alice@0850 alice@0920 bob@1200` returns `[alice]`.
- `amy@1000 amy@1030 amy@1100` returns `[]` because the span is exactly 60 minutes.
- `zoe@0000 zoe@0000 zoe@0001` returns `[zoe]`.
hints: Group times by employee before checking windows.
Sort each employee's minutes and look at every block of three consecutive accesses.
A three-access block identifies a qualifying employee when its last time minus first time is less than 60 minutes.
inputSyntax: Input: name@HHmm access entries separated by spaces, for example: alice@0830 alice@0850 alice@0920 bob@1200
